name: cdp
description: A risk-based development planning Skill for AI Coding Agents. Use when invoked as cdp, $cdp, cdp:, or controlled-development-planning. Clarifies vague requirements, inspects evidence, classifies risk as S/M/L/XL, locks scope, and requires valid human approval before any implementation or persistence.
author: webszy

install.codex: npx skills add https://github.com/webszy/my-skills --skill cdp -a codex -g -y
install.claudeCode: npx skills add https://github.com/webszy/my-skills --skill cdp -a claude-code -g -y
install.both: npx skills add https://github.com/webszy/my-skills --skill cdp -a codex -a claude-code -g -y
